title: Small and rough
text: Small and rough. I like the idea of this little tray and I hope to find a use for it.  To be honest, it is smaller than I expected and the finish is rough vs. smooth.  Its farmhouse, but not something that I can find a use for at this point.  I think it is much too expensive for what it is.

product_metadata.title: Sweet Water Decor Large Rustic Rectangular Tray for Home | Kitchen and Bathroom Dispenser Holder | Jewelry Dish | Wooden Soap Bottle Holder | Trays for Counters | Vanity Plate | Farmhouse Dish Décor
features: RUSTIC ACCENT FOR BATHROOMS & KITCHENS. This wooden vanity tray brings a hint of warmth to your home with its modern farmhouse aesthetic. Place your new wooden tray as a soap dispenser holder in any bathroom, kitchen countertop, side table or coffee table to add a sleek and rustic accent to the room.

VERSATILE USE. Our stylish wooden vanity tray is the perfect match for your favorite Sweet Water Decor soap dispenser, scented candle or safety match jar, but the possibilities are endless! This rustic wooden tray holds anything from soap dispensers, jewelry and keys to cosmetics, small plants and small crafts.

HOW TO CARE FOR YOUR WOOD TRAY. Our antique soap dispenser tray is easy to care for! Simply wipe with a soft, damp cloth or gently rinse with water and pat dry. (DISCLAIMER: This is a product hand-crafted with real wood and coated with a stain. For optimal use, please avoid water and moisture buildup in or around the tray. This product is not dishwasher or microwave safe.)

STYLISH HOME DECOR GIFT. Your friends and family will love receiving this cottage style tray as a beautiful housewarming gift or party favor. For the ultimate gift combo, try pairing our wooden tray with your favorite Sweet Water Decor soap dispenser, scented candle or Wooden Safety Match Jar!

WOODEN TRAY DETAILS & DIMENSIONS. Our hand-crafted wooden holder was designed in the United States and made with lightweight, distressed Paulownia Wood. The compact size will easily fit in any kitchen or bathroom at 6.9” L x 3.7” W x 0.75” H.
